package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"

	machine "github.com/whitaker-io/machine/v4"
)

// Order is the payload the pushed flow carries. It is the type the exported
// ingest must be instantiated at, and the wrong-type leg of the typing test
// pushes something else through the same field.
type Order struct {
	ID string
}

// deliveredCount is how many data the HOST pushes through the ingest. The
// transport pushes none, so this is the whole population.
const deliveredCount = 2

// Feed is the source transport, and it DELIVERS NOTHING ON PURPOSE. Start opens
// the edge and returns; no packet is ever minted here.
//
// That is what makes the token below evidence about the ingest specifically: if
// the exported ingest were merely typed and never wired to the machine, nothing
// at all would reach the sink and the program would fail on its deadline.
func Feed() machine.EdgeFactory[Order] {
	return func(node string, report machine.Report) (machine.Edge[Order], error) {
		return &feedEdge{ch: make(chan machine.Packet[Order], deliveredCount)}, nil
	}
}

type feedEdge struct {
	ch chan machine.Packet[Order]
}

func (e *feedEdge) Start(ctx context.Context) error { return nil }

// Send is the path the exported ingest ultimately reaches. Every datum this flow
// ever sees arrives here.
func (e *feedEdge) Send(ctx context.Context, packet machine.Packet[Order]) error {
	select {
	case e.ch <- packet:
		return nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
}

func (e *feedEdge) Receive() <-chan machine.Packet[Order] { return e.ch }

func (e *feedEdge) Close() error { return nil }

var (
	mu   sync.Mutex
	seen int
)

// Tally counts arrivals.
func Tally(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order {
	mu.Lock()
	seen++
	mu.Unlock()

	return f.Value()
}

// Report prints the LOCKED TOKEN once every pushed datum has arrived.
func Report(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order {
	mu.Lock()
	count := seen
	mu.Unlock()
	if count == deliveredCount {
		Emit(count)
	}

	return f.Value()
}

// done is closed once the token has been printed, so main exits on the data
// rather than on a timer.
var done = make(chan struct{})

var emitOnce sync.Once

// Emit prints the locked token from the fixture's own code.
func Emit(count int) {
	emitOnce.Do(func() {
		fmt.Printf("flow-push: delivered=%d\n", count)
		close(done)
	})
}
